parsed.why: Federal sex-at-birth passport rule, visa case-note tagging and refusal risk reach every trans traveller; facility bans in ~21 states, criminal trespass in four; allied advisories. Courts and protective states only partly mitigate; no trans-specific identity offence.

No same-sex criminalisation; gender-identity hate-speech and hate-crime law plus conversion ban, but enforcement documented inconsistent. One island half runs non-binary-inclusive recognition, the other offers no recognition and thin recourse.

Working remedy: sex-discrimination law covering gender identity with damages awarded, plus February 2025 hate-crime law; no traveller-facing restriction. Youth-care restrictions and uneven state vilification coverage are the main friction.
Quiet tolerance, no sodomy law, culturally legible trans presentation; but no protections or recourse, blocked LGBTI content, and 'public immodesty' invites state attention. Thin, dated record.

Article 521 imprisons trans-feminine presentation up to six years; morality article still enforced via arrests and anal exams; no legal gender recognition; police barriers and rising violence. Courts narrowing Article 534 only partly mitigate.
